source.title: Japanese Pufferfish Art Print, Mid Century Modern Wall Art, Colorful Fish Illustration Poster, Minimal Coastal Home Decor

analysis.summary: A whimsical cluster of colorful, patterned pufferfish floating amidst elegant Japanese calligraphy on a warm neutral background.
analysis.subject: A variety of puffed-up fugu fish with distinct patterns like dots, stripes, and spikes.
analysis.setting: A minimalist, parchment-like beige space suggesting a calm, stylized underwater scene.
analysis.action: Floating in a dense, overlapping school, looking in different directions.
analysis.style: Japanese woodblock print aesthetic mixed with Mid-Century Modern graphic design, featuring flat color planes, screen-print textures, and naive, rounded forms.
analysis.composition: Vertical portrait orientation with an asymmetrical balance; fish are clustered on the left and center while vertical calligraphy occupies the right, utilizing overlapping shapes to create depth.
analysis.typography: Vertical Japanese calligraphy in black ink on the right side; a small red square artist seal (hanko) in the bottom left corner; small horizontal descriptive text at the very bottom.
analysis.mood: Playful yet sophisticated, blending traditional eastern art with modern decorative charm.
analysis.audience: Interior designers and homeowners looking for coastal-themed or Japandi-style wall art for kitchens, bathrooms, or living rooms.
analysis.hook: The charm of 'dangerously cute' pufferfish rendered in a high-end, textured graphic style that feels both vintage and contemporary.

outputs.title: Floating Fugu Gathering
outputs.brief: A cluster of eight round pufferfish floats on a warm beige (#d2ccb3) background. The largest fish is dark blue (#1a364b) with yellow spikes at the top, followed by a cream (#f4f3e9) fish below it and a golden yellow (#c1a01c) fish in the center. Vertical Japanese calligraphy in black ink runs down the right side of the frame. A small red (#b53d2f) square hanko seal sits in the bottom left corner. The style uses screen-print textures with flat color planes and visible grain.

outputs.title: Patterned Sea Swell
outputs.brief: Nine colorful pufferfish of various sizes overlap in the center-left of a portrait frame. The fish feature muted red (#b53d2f), olive green (#6b703e), and off-white (#f4f3e9) bodies with varied patterns like polka dots and dashed spikes. A column of vertical black calligraphy is placed slightly more central than the reference, while the background remains a flat #d2ccb3. Texture is heavy with woodblock-style overlaps and slightly misaligned color layers for a vintage feel.

outputs.title: Diagonal Fugu Procession
outputs.brief: A diagonal procession of pufferfish swims from the bottom-left corner toward the top-right against a #d2ccb3 backdrop. The fish vary in pattern, including one large olive green (#6b703e) fish with cream spikes and a small dotted blue (#1a364b) fish trailing behind. Vertical calligraphy is placed in the top-left and bottom-right empty spaces to balance the movement. All shapes are rounded with a hand-cut paper appearance and tactile screen-printed grain.

outputs.title: Depths of the Kelp Forest
outputs.brief: A trio of oversized pufferfish dominates the lower half of the frame, with smaller fish receding into the distance above them in a vertical stack. Stylized vertical seaweed stalks in olive green (#6b703e) rise between the fish. A pale cream (#f4f3e9) sun-like circle sits behind the top cluster of fish on the #d2ccb3 background. Textures show distressed ink layers and white flecks suggesting sea foam, with black calligraphy integrated between the seaweed.

outputs.title: Fugu Mandala Circle
outputs.brief: A circular kaleidoscope arrangement of twelve pufferfish, their tails pointing toward a central empty point on a #d2ccb3 background. The fish alternate colors between dark blue (#1a364b), muted red (#b53d2f), and golden yellow (#c1a01c) to create a rhythmic pattern. Short blocks of black calligraphy are placed in each corner of the poster, framing the central circle. The rendering features flat, bold shapes with heavy wood-grain texture and a red hanko seal positioned in the exact center.
